description: Service Industries Textiles Limited was incorporated in Pakistan in 1962 as a private limited company, converted to public limited status in 1970, and is listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange. Its principal activity is the manufacture and sale of yarn made from raw cotton and synthetic fibre, carried out at its mills on Rehman Shaheed Road in Gujrat, with its registered office at 38 Empress Road, Lahore. The company has been reporting losses in its spinning business, which its directors attribute to energy costs and conditions in the Punjab spinning sector.
sourceNote: Written from: Service Industries Textiles Limited website (sitl.com.pk: about us, company profile, contact us) and the company's Annual Report 2026 - company information and directors' report (sitl.com.pk/wp-content/uploads/accounts/2025-2026/Annual2026.pdf) (accessed 2026-10-17)
